nodes._instruction: List of nodes with individual dynamics (optional, for heterogeneous networks)

edges._instruction: List of directed edges with coupling references (optional, for explicit edge definition)

coupling_library._instruction: Reusable coupling configurations referenced by edges (e.g., 'instant', 'delayed', 'inhibitory')

number_of_regions._instruction: Number of regions (derived from nodes if not set)

number_of_nodes._instruction: Number of nodes in the network (derived from nodes if not set)

global_coupling_strength._instruction: Global scaling factor for all coupling weights

conduction_speed._instruction: Conduction speed for computing delays from distances

distance_unit._instruction: Unit for distances/lengths in the network (e.g., 'mm', 'm', 'cm')

time_unit._instruction: Default time unit for the network (e.g., 'ms', 's')
